panels.title: Plan: 'How does Shakespeare present the consequences of ambition?'
points: Thesis: ambition freed from conscience destroys the self and the state
Answer: Ultimately, Shakespeare suggests that ambition, once it silences conscience, destroys everything it gains: Macbeth wins a crown and loses the meaning of life itself.
